override_note: CME Holiday Notes: orders after Sunday September 6 pre-open have Tuesday September 8 trade date.

verified_scope.scope_note: Only the explicitly listed dates are verified; intervening historical missing dates are not inferred from recurring federal holidays.

limitations: Historical verified dates are explicit per-date entries; all other absent daily labels remain unverified calendar/source gaps.
No complete holiday-specific hourly session or halt calendar is encoded.
No-settlement notices do not mean the exchange is closed all day.
Only the September 7, 2026 to September 8, 2026 trade-date override is explicitly verified here; other holiday mappings remain provisional.
Expected normal weekdays with missing or quarantined OHLC remain PARTIAL outside the verified exclusions.
Half-hour-start and shortened vendor H1 buckets remain nominal time intervals, not tick times.

modified_settlement_days.note: Settlement time is not the exchange trading-close time.
Normal settlement does not prove full hourly chart coverage.

historical_price_quality_evidence.note: Capture-specific evidence for absent daily labels; not proof that those dates were open exchange sessions. Only applied while the corresponding price label remains missing.

recovery_attempt.methods: 31 anomaly/null dates queried on query1 and query2; 131 other absent dates queried through 16 annual query1 windows plus five targeted query2 windows. No H1 retry, surrogate instrument, interpolation or close-to-OHLC replacement.
